site.title: Rust, for developers
site.description: An interactive Rust course for developers who already know how to program. Three tracks: basic, intermediate and advanced.

home.heroTitle: Learn Rust the way you learned your second language: by comparison.
home.heroLead: You already know loops, closures and generics. This course skips the basics of programming and focuses on what is actually different in Rust: ownership, the borrow checker, the type system and a runtime that is almost nothing at all.

why.title: No garbage collector
why.text: Memory is freed deterministically when its owner goes out of scope. No pauses, no finalizers, no reference counting unless you ask for it.

why.title: Checked at compile time
why.text: Data races, use-after-free and null dereferences are rejected by the compiler, not discovered in production.

why.title: Zero-cost abstractions
why.text: Iterators, generics and closures compile down to the same machine code you would write by hand.

why.title: Errors are values
why.text: No exceptions. Failure is part of the function signature through Result and Option.

home.tracksLead: Each track mixes concept explanations, diagrams and runnable examples. Every code block marked as a playground can be edited and executed in your browser.
home.howText: Editable playgrounds are compiled and run on the official Rust Playground (play.rust-lang.org). Visualizations run entirely in your browser.
